description: Rear extension to the lower ground flat
decision_conditions:
The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

<p>Prior to superstructure works, detailed specification, a drainage layout and a management &amp;
maintenance plan (where applicable) of at least one suitable sustainable drainage system (i.e.
water butt with overflow, raingarden, bioretention planter box, living roof (substrate depth of 80
150mm excluding the vegetative mat), permeable paving etc.) shall be submitted to, and
approved by the LPA, in consultation with the LLFA. If soakaways i.e. plastic modules and
soakaway rings are used, an infiltration test must be carried out to ensure that the capacity of the
soil is suitable for infiltration. It must be demonstrated that there will be no increase in surface.</p><p>Reason: In the interests of flood mitigation&nbsp;</p>

<p><span style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">&nbsp;Tree and ground protection for all retained trees at the neighbouring site must be implemented to protect the root protection area (calculated as described in BS5837:2012: Trees in relation to construction - Recommendations) for the duration of all site works, including demolition, undertaken in connection with the development hereby approved. The protective barrier shall consist of a suitable solid barrier such as wooden hoarding (minimum 1.8m high) securely mounted to a timber framework and well braced to the ground to resist impacts and prevent displacement. This protection must remain in place and fully intact until all construction works are completed and all machinery and materials have been removed from the site.</span><br style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;"><br style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;"><span style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">REASON: To comply with the requirements of Section 197(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.</span></p>
